text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=router-latency (severity=warning) — Threshold breach: p95 latency > 350ms in us-west for 2m. Pager: oncall-eng. https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 created — triggered by metric alert. Details: https://pd.example/INC12345

julia: acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboards now.

mike: seeing a sharp p95 jump, affected hosts: router-pool-usw-3,4. error rate not up, just latency.

sam: looking at traces — lots of requests stuck at kv-cache lookup step, tail latency there jumping. Sending span sample.

alex: hmm, we did a small rolling push to router-pool-usw ~3m ago. Could be kv warmup / cold caches.

julia: ok mitigation plan: 1) route a fraction of traffic off the affected pool to fallback pool 2) bump router concurrency limit to reduce queueing 3) watch.

mike: routing change in flight. command:
```bash
# move 30% traffic away from pool-usw-3,4
redwood route update --service router --region us-west --split '{"pool-usw-3":0.35,"pool-usw-1":0.65}'
```

incident-bot: command accepted, route update started (owner=julia).

sam: sanity check on traces now — kv-cache latencies on the moved hosts are still high but overall request tail starts to drop in the samples.

mike: bumped concurrency on pool-usw-3 from 80 -> 120 to reduce queueing.

alex: note: we should avoid full pool drain, just partial to keep capacity. 30% looks good.

julia: monitoring: p95 back to ~220ms after routing + concurrency ~2m. Still watching for churn.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by julia. Escalation suspended.

mike: running a quick health check across pools: all other metrics stable. No customer-facing errors reported from synthetic checks.

sam: checking logs for root cause — kv-cache hit rates dropped suddenly on pool-usw-3,4 at time of deploy. Might be stale eviction policy + a spike in new sessions.

alex: can we add a short-term TTL increase for the cache to reduce misses? small config flip.

julia: doing TTL bump to 5m from 1m on the impacted pools. CLI:
```json
{"service":"kv-cache","region":"us-west","pools":["pool-usw-3","pool-usw-4"],"ttl_seconds":300}
```

incident-bot: config change queued (id=cfg-9012) — applying to pool-usw-3,4.

mike: metrics show cache hit rate recovering, tail latency holding. Good.

pagerduty-bot: Monitoring indicates alert condition cleared for INC12345 — auto-resolve triggered by alerting system.

julia: thanks team. I'll keep a 30m watch, then hand off to tara for overnight monitoring. TL;DR: brief latency spike from kv-cache cold/warm behavior following a rolling deploy; mitigated by partial traffic reroute + concurrency bump + TTL tweak. No customer-visible errors observed.

tara: taking watch. If anything flares up please @tara. Also, please file a tiny follow-up doc with timeline and mitigation so we can tune deploy/gating.

mike: will capture the timeline and graphs and drop into #postmortems/ops later today.

sam: tentative RCA: rolling deploy caused localized cache evictions, high-miss storm -> tail latency spike. Follow-ups: 1) increase grace period for cache during deploys 2) add a small rolling-warmup traffic diversion 3) add alert that ties p95 spike to cache-miss-rate so we can triage faster.

julia: noted. closing this thread after handoff. Thanks all :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 resolved (auto-resolve).

incident-bot: Thread closed.
